purpose: Append-only routing of substantive unique sources and calibration results discovered after the canonical snapshot was created.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or a negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Duplicate mirrors, navigation pages, and repeated copies of the same substantive source are provenance aliases, not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Substantive off-topic publications surfaced by search may be routed as reusable methodology/domain intelligence or negative-control material; search appearance never grants Glob evidence weight.

wii_uniform_endpoint_topology_approximat.assumption: Each classified transition independently selects one even and one odd level uniformly. This is not the final topology-preserving null because actual transition degrees are heterogeneous.
wii_uniform_endpoint_topology_approximat.interpretation: The observed 39699.84/41494.48 pair shares an even a^4P_(3/2) endpoint. Under this simplified model such a shared even endpoint is about a 1.61% pair event; shared either endpoint about 2.36%. Global multiple testing and real degree heterogeneity must be included before significance is claimed.
